steps.tip: Young nightsabers and thistle boars wander all around the base of Aldrassil. Start killing as soon as you leave the conservator.
Melithar stands just north of Ilthalaine. The dryad is a short walk south-west.
Loop around Aldrassil. Tag anything near you; the two mob types share the same ground.
Your class letter. Hand it to your trainer inside Aldrassil for a little XP and your first spells.
Nature's Call is a Forever quest: the Gnarlpine Totems sit in the same grell camp west of Aldrassil, so do both together.
Forever racial quest from Shanda: cast Elune's Light and Shadowmeld, then talk to her again.

steps.text: Train your level 2-4 spells inside Aldrassil
Optional: pick a gathering profession from the junior trainers around Aldrassil
prof: Forever adds junior Herbalism, Mining and Skinning trainers in the starting areas. They teach the first rank, so you can gather from level 1.
Herbalism pairs well with Teldrassil: Peacebloom and Silverleaf grow along every path here.

steps.tip: Grells drop the Fel Moss. Grab the totems on the ground between pulls.
The Webwood spiders live up the slope north of Aldrassil, at the Shadowthread Cave.
Dirania stands on the east edge of Shadowglen.
The Mangy Nightsabers and Thistle Boars roam north of Aldrassil, on the way to the spider cave.
Iverron lies poisoned at the mouth of the Shadowthread Cave.
Stay near the cave entrance; the spiders outside respawn fast enough.
Githyiss the Vile is a named spider just inside the cave. The fang starts a Forever quest worth 450 XP.
steps.speed: Speedrun: only if Githyiss is up when you pass; do not wait for a respawn.

steps.text: Back at Aldrassil: turn in Webwood Venom and accept Webwood Egg from Gilshalan

steps.tip: Hyacinth Mushrooms grow around the base of Aldrassil; the Moonpetal Lily is near the pool just north of it.
The eggs are at the very back of the Shadowthread Cave. Kill spiders on the way for the Webwood Ichor.
Any Webwood Spider can drop the Ichor.
The antidote is on a timer. Go straight to Iverron and skip the other turn-ins for now.
steps.speed: Speedrun: run back to Iverron right away, the timer is generous but the walk is long.

steps.text: Turn in Webwood Egg to Gilshalan and accept Tenaron's Summons

steps.tip: The Shadowglen moonwell is a short walk north of Aldrassil.
Forever Camping quest: read the Lost Journal near Tenaron. It sends you to Lyreena in Dolanaar.
steps.speed: Speedrun: worth it. The Camping chain gives over 1,000 XP for two minutes of walking inside Dolanaar.

steps.tip: Priests: Shanda sends you to Laurna in Dolanaar for your next spell quest.

steps.text: Train your new spells before leaving Shadowglen

steps.tip: Porthannius waits on the road south out of Shadowglen. The delivery ends at the Dolanaar inn on your way.
Dolanaar is your hub for the rest of Teldrassil.

steps.text: Set your hearthstone at the Dolanaar inn

steps.tip: Twisted Hatred needs Lord Melenas in Fel Rock, north of Dolanaar. Keep it for the western loop at level 8.
Forever quest from Aldia. The pelts come off the Nightsabers right outside Dolanaar.
Lyreena teaches you Camping. Build the campfire right next to her.
Camping 101 has one quest per profession and you can only take one. Cooking is the shortest, since Zarrin is in Dolanaar; pick another if you plan that profession.
steps.prof: Forever: every profession unlocks a camp feature at skill 20, and Cooking gives the Basic Campfire at skill 1.

steps.text: Talk to Zarrin, the cook in Dolanaar, and turn in Camping 101: Cooking

steps.tip: Zenn waits just east of the village. Every fang, feather and silk comes from mobs around Dolanaar.
Nightsabers, Strigid Owls and Webwood Lurkers all live in the woods between Dolanaar and the road east.
Sentinel Shaya is south of Dolanaar. Heal her with Lesser Heal (Rank 2), then buff her with Power Word: Fortitude.
Gaerolas hides in a hut in Starbreeze Village, east of Dolanaar. The Gnarlpine there hit harder than the wildlife, so pull one at a time.
The Starbreeze moonwell is at the west edge of the village.
Tallonkai's Dresser is in the house at the far east end of Starbreeze.
Zenn is on your way back to Dolanaar. Fel Cones fall near the trees south of Dolanaar, by Lake Al'Ameth.
The Gnarlpine Mystics camp north of Starbreeze Village. One of them carries the jewel.
steps.speed: Speedrun: the mystics are a short run from Starbreeze and the quest pays well. Pick up Gnarlpine kills on the way.

steps.tip: Denalan tends his planters on the south shore of Lake Al'Ameth.
Timberlings walk the shore around the lake. Kill them for seeds and pick up sprouts in the same loop.
Timberling Sprouts are small plants on the ground west of the lake.
Fel Cones lie under the trees north-west of the lake, toward Dolanaar.
Zenn is a short run north, just east of Dolanaar.

segments.title: Fel Rock and Ban'ethil Barrow Den

steps.tip: Moon Priestess Amara stands on the road west of Dolanaar.
Fel Rock is the cave north of the road. Lord Melenas is at the back; the satyrs inside come in pairs, so rest before each pull.
The Ambushers hide in the trees on both sides of the road further west.
Shayla stands on the road just outside Darnassus. Gnarlpine Shamans in the barrow den drop the fangs.
Oben Rageclaw sleeps at the entrance of Ban'ethil Barrow Den, south of the road.
Gnarlpine Shamans are in and around the barrow den entrance.
Fifteen fangs is a lot; keep killing Gnarlpine here and you will finish it before you leave the den.
The four relic chests are spread through the barrow den. Clear the furbolgs room by room and loot each chest as you reach it.
Rageclaw is in the deepest chamber of the den. When he dies, use the Voodoo Charm on his body.
Forever escort. Sentinel Lynessa is held in the barrow den; talk to her and walk her out. You report to Sentinel Kyra in Dolanaar.

steps.text: Back on the road east: turn in The Road to Darnassus to Moon Priestess Amara

steps.tip: Forever follow-up: the Befouled Webwoods and Xethorr are just north of Fel Rock, on the way to Darnassus.
Sentinel Kyra stands in the middle of Dolanaar.
Forever quest: Sentinel Eralya is on the road to the Oracle Glade, which you reach after Darnassus.
Forever breadcrumb from Laurna to the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. It opens Tears of the Moon, a good level 12 quest.

segments.title: Pools of Arlithrien and Gnarlpine Hold

steps.tip: Pools of Arlithrien are south of the barrow den. Fill the phial at the moonwell.
The Strange Fruited Plant grows on the hillside south of the pools. Take it now; the quest ends at Denalan.
Ursal the Mauler roams Gnarlpine Hold, just west of the fruit plant. He hits hard; pull him away from the furbolgs and fight him alone.
steps.speed: Speedrun: after Ursal, die on purpose and take the spirit healer just south of Dolanaar instead of walking back.

steps.text: If you are not level 10 yet, kill Gnarlpine Pathfinders around the hold until you are
steps.tip: The class quests in Dolanaar need level 10. A handful of kills here is usually enough.

steps.text: Lake Al'Ameth: turn in The Glowing Fruit to Denalan
steps.tip: Denalan is on your way back north to Dolanaar.

steps.text: Back in Dolanaar: turn in Crown of the Earth to Corithras and accept the next step
At level 10, train your spells and pick up your class quest in Dolanaar

steps.tip: Warriors: Kyra Windblade sends you to Elanaria in Darnassus.
Rogues: Jannok sends you to Syurna in Darnassus.
Priests: Laurna sends you to Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon.
Druids: Kal sends you to Mathrengyl in Darnassus to start the bear form quests.
Hunters: tame a Webwood Lurker with the Taming Rod. They are just south of Dolanaar.
Use the rod from range and stand still for the whole cast.
The Befouled Webwoods crawl around the hill north of Fel Rock. Xethorr is a named spider among them.
Shayla is at the bend in the road below Darnassus.
Rellian is in the Cenarion Enclave, in the north-west of Darnassus. Mossy Tumors drop from the bigger Timberlings near the Oracle Glade.
Warriors: Vorlus Vilehoof is just east of the barrow den. Do him when you head back toward Dolanaar.
Rogues: Sethir the Ancient sits on a hill north of the Oracle Glade.
Druids: keep Moonglade in your log. You go there from Darnassus on your last visit.
Priests: Alathea trains you in the Temple of the Moon.
Lady Sathrah is a big spider on the ridge north of the Oracle Glade.
Priestess A'moora is in the Temple of the Moon. You do not need the breadcrumb to take Tears of the Moon.
steps.speed: Speedrun: skip the Sisterhood breadcrumbs and take Tears of the Moon straight from A'moora; Sathrah and the fountain step together pay over 2,000 XP.

steps.tip: Eralya lies wounded on the road to the Oracle Glade. Byancie in Dolanaar can help her.
Arynia guards the Oracle Glade. The Bloodfeather harpies nest on the slopes all around it.
The Oracle Glade moonwell is right next to Arynia.
Harpies cast and run; pull them away from their friends.
Forever quest: three named harpies, each at a different nest around the glade.
The three named harpies each hold a nest around the glade. Clear the adds before you engage.
Mist is a lost nightsaber cub among the harpies. She follows you back to Arynia; do not run too far ahead.
The Strange Fronded Plant grows by the water north-west of the glade.
Touch the Oracle Tree bark. Teldrassil goes to Fandral in Darnassus and opens Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
Rogues: Sethir is up the hill to the north. Clear around him before you pull.
Lady Sathrah drifts around the ridge with her spiders. She is level 12; use a full health and mana bar.
Elder Timberlings and Mire Beasts around the Wellspring lake drop the tumors.
Blackmoss the Fetid is a level 13 timberling by the Wellspring. His heart starts a good quest for Denalan; skip him if he is too strong for you.
Back in the Cenarion Enclave.
Grove of the Ancients ends at Onu in southern Darkshore. Keep it for the next pack.

steps.text: Use the fountain in the Temple of the Moon and turn in Sathrah's Sacrifice

steps.tip: Rogues: Syurna gives you the reward right away.
Hearth back to Dolanaar instead of walking across the island.
Back in Dolanaar. Buy an Empty Vial from Narret and one Refreshing Spring Water from Danlyia right here; the quest needs both.
Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
Plant the frond, then use the sprouted frond next to Denalan.
Click the Sprouted Frond by Denalan's planters.

steps.text: Plant the heart in Denalan's Planter

steps.tip: Forever change: lashers are no longer immune to Nature, so druids can use Wrath on them. Lasher Sproutlings cover the shore around the lake.
Oakenscowl is a big timberling in the cave south of the lake.
Hunters: Nightsaber Stalkers prowl the woods west of the lake. Tame one, then dismiss it and keep going.
Warriors: Vorlus Vilehoof is east of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. He is level 10; start at full health and save Bloodrage for the pull.

steps.text: Back at the lake: turn in Oakenscowl to Denalan

steps.tip: Byancie trains First Aid as well; learn it now if you have not.
Easing Suffering takes the salve back to Eralya on the road to the Oracle Glade. Do it on your way to Darnassus.
Hunters: Strigid Screechers perch in the trees west of Lake Al'Ameth. Tame one and come back.
Hunters: Strigid Screechers sit in the trees west of the lake.
Hunters: Training the Beast ends at Jocaste in Darnassus, where you learn pet training.

steps.text: Train your new spells in Dolanaar
On the way west, turn in Easing Suffering to Sentinel Eralya

steps.tip: Fandral sends you to the Temple of the Moon for the last steps of Crown of the Earth.
Forever chain: Lariia waits outside the temple.
Tyrande Whisperwind herself turns in the last step.
Warriors: the Shade of Elura is on the coast of Darkshore. Keep the quest for the next pack.
Hunters: Jocaste teaches you to train your pet.

steps.text: Druids: Teleport to Moonglade and turn in Moonglade to Dendrite Starblaze
steps.tip: Druids learn Teleport: Moonglade at level 10. Dendrite is in Nighthaven.
The Great Bear Spirit is in the hills west of Nighthaven. Just talk to it.
Druids: from Nighthaven, take the druid flight to Rut'theran and walk up through the portal to Mathrengyl. Body and Heart is done in Darkshore.
Mydrannul is on the Tradesmen's Terrace. Then take the portal down to Rut'theran Village.

steps.text: Rut'theran Village: turn in Nessa Shadowsong and accept The Bounty of Teldrassil

steps.tip: Flight to Auberdine ends at Laird in Auberdine; the next pack starts there.

steps.text: Fly to Auberdine in Darkshore
steps.tip: There is also a boat from the Rut'theran dock to Auberdine if you would rather save the flight money.
